audience: freelancers and small businesses who send invoices and estimates with Hiveage

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and the total outstanding
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by state (draft, sent, viewed, partial or paid) with totals and dates, and adds up what is still outstanding.

useCases.title: See everything for one client
useCases.text: The AI finds a client in your network and lists their invoices, estimates and recurring invoices.

useCases.title: Review recurring invoices and saved items
useCases.text: The AI lists recurring invoice profiles with interval and next billing date, the invoices one profile made, and your saved line items with price and unit.

useCases.title: Add a client and create a draft invoice or estimate
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice or estimate with a unique statement number for a client. It starts as a draft and nothing is emailed. It can add the client first.

useCases.title: Record a payment on an invoice
useCases.text: The AI enters a payment received on an invoice, and marks an offline payment such as a bank transfer as realized so it counts as received.

useCases.title: Email an invoice, a reminder or an estimate
useCases.text: The AI emails an invoice or estimate to the client, or a payment reminder for an invoice, with the default template or your own text. It cannot be undone.
